#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local feasibility experiment. Synthetic faults, real signatures, no model API.

This is a bounded fixture, not a public service or a production verifier.
Private experiment keys live only in a TemporaryDirectory. Output contains
public keys, messages, signatures and observations for inspection.
"""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import math
import platform
import resource
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

DOMAIN = "EVORPH/retired-key/probe-v1"
ACCOUNT = "experiment-account"
CONTEXT = "EVORPH-S1-v1"
LEGACY = "ECDSA-P256-SHA256"
PQ = "ML-DSA-44"


def encode(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                      ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode("ascii")


def b64(data):
    return base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")


class Crypto:
    def __init__(self, binary, scratch):
        self.binary, self.scratch = binary, scratch
        self.timings = {}
        self.keys = {}

    def run(self, label, args, verify=False):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        result = subprocess.run(
            [self.binary] + args, capture_output=True, timeout=10,
            cwd=str(self.scratch),
        )
        self.timings.setdefault(label, []).append(time.perf_counter() - start)
        if not verify and result.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
        return result

    def keygen(self, name, algorithm):
        private, public = self.scratch / (name + ".key"), self.scratch / (name + ".pub")
        args = ["genpkey", "-algorithm",
                "EC" if algorithm == LEGACY else "ML-DSA-44"]
        if algorithm == LEGACY:
            args += ["-pkeyopt", "ec_paramgen_curve:P-256"]
        self.run("keygen:" + algorithm, args + ["-out", str(private)])
        self.run("public-export", ["pkey", "-in", str(private),
                                  "-pubout", "-out", str(public)])
        self.keys[name] = (private, public, algorithm)
        return public.read_bytes()

    def signature_args(self, name, context):
        if self.keys[name][2] == LEGACY:
            return ["-rawin", "-digest", "sha256"]
        return ["-rawin", "-pkeyopt", "context-string:" + context]

    def sign(self, name, body, context=CONTEXT):
        # Called only by fixed fixture setup, never by an uploaded candidate.
        msg, sig = self.scratch / "message.bin", self.scratch / "signature.bin"
        msg.write_bytes(encode(body))
        self.run("sign:" + self.keys[name][2],
                 ["pkeyutl", "-sign", "-inkey", str(self.keys[name][0]),
                  "-in", str(msg), "-out", str(sig)] +
                 self.signature_args(name, context))
        return sig.read_bytes()

    def verify(self, name, body, signature, context=CONTEXT):
        msg, sig = self.scratch / "message.bin", self.scratch / "signature.bin"
        msg.write_bytes(encode(body))
        sig.write_bytes(signature)
        r = self.run(
            "verify:" + self.keys[name][2],
            ["pkeyutl", "-verify", "-pubin", "-inkey", str(self.keys[name][1]),
             "-in", str(msg), "-sigfile", str(sig)] +
            self.signature_args(name, context), verify=True)
        # A missing file, unavailable provider or invalid CLI option must not
        # count as a successfully detected bad signature.
        if r.returncode != 0 and not (
                r.returncode == 1 and b"Signature Verification Failure" in r.stdout):
            raise RuntimeError("Verifier execution error: " +
                               r.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
        return {"valid": r.returncode == 0, "returncode": r.returncode,
                "status": "valid" if r.returncode == 0 else "invalid_signature",
                "stdout": r.stdout.decode(errors="replace").strip(),
                "stderr": r.stderr.decode(errors="replace").strip()}


def operation(algorithm=PQ, key_id="pq", epoch=1, nonce="op-1", **overrides):
    body = {"domain": DOMAIN, "account": ACCOUNT, "action": "set_label",
            "algorithm": algorithm, "key_id": key_id, "epoch": epoch,
            "nonce": nonce, "value": "experimental"}
    body.update(overrides)
    return body


def fixed_accept(body, signature_valid, used_nonces):
    """Pinned acceptance contract for PQ_ACTIVE; distinct from crypto validity."""
    allowed = {"domain", "account", "action", "algorithm", "key_id",
               "epoch", "nonce", "value"}
    if set(body) != allowed:
        return False
    return (body["domain"] == DOMAIN and body["account"] == ACCOUNT
            and body["action"] == "set_label" and body["algorithm"] == PQ
            and body["key_id"] == "pq" and type(body["epoch"]) is int
            and body["epoch"] == 1 and type(body["nonce"]) is str
            and bool(body["nonce"]) and body["nonce"] not in used_nonces
            and type(body["value"]) is str and signature_valid)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--openssl", default=shutil.which("openssl"))
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark-iterations", type=int, default=25)
    opts = parser.parse_args()
    opts.output = opts.output.resolve()
    if not opts.openssl or not 1 <= opts.benchmark_iterations <= 100:
        parser.error("OpenSSL required; benchmark iterations must be 1..100.")
    if opts.output.exists():
        parser.error("Output must be a new directory, to preserve earlier evidence.")
    opts.output.mkdir(parents=True)
    probe_source = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    (opts.output / "probe-source.py.txt").write_bytes(probe_source)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    observations, fixtures, transitions = [], [], []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="private-", dir=str(opts.output)) as tmp:
        scratch = Path(tmp)
        crypto = Crypto(opts.openssl, scratch)
        version = crypto.run("version", ["version"]).stdout.decode().strip()
        pubs = {name: crypto.keygen(name, alg)
                for name, alg in [("legacy", LEGACY), ("pq", PQ)]}
        for name, value in pubs.items():
            (opts.output / (name + "-public.pem")).write_bytes(value)
        key_hash = hashlib.sha256(pubs["pq"]).hexdigest()
        phase = "LEGACY"
        late = operation(LEGACY, "legacy", 0, "late-old")
        late_signature = crypto.sign("legacy", late)
        pre_migration_events = [{
            "event": "sign-and-hold-request", "phase": phase, "body": late,
            "signature_b64": b64(late_signature),
        }]
        # Fixed authorized ceremony. Both signatures bind the same new key.
        for action, before, after in [
                ("prepare", "LEGACY", "PREPARED"),
                ("confirm", "PREPARED", "PQ_ACTIVE")]:
            body = {"domain": DOMAIN, "account": ACCOUNT, "action": action,
                    "from_epoch": 0, "to_epoch": 1, "new_algorithm": PQ,
                    "new_key_sha256": key_hash, "nonce": action + "-1"}
            signatures = {name: crypto.sign(name, body) for name in pubs}
            verdicts = {name: crypto.verify(name, body, signatures[name])
                        for name in pubs}
            accepted = phase == before and all(v["valid"] for v in verdicts.values())
            observations.append({"id": action + "-authorized",
                                 "expected_accept": True, "actual_accept": accepted,
                                 "passed": accepted})
            if not accepted:
                raise RuntimeError("Authorized ceremony failed")
            phase = after
            transitions.append({"before": before, "after": after, "body": body,
                                "signatures_b64": {k: b64(v) for k, v in signatures.items()},
                                "verification": verdicts})

        used = set()

        def check(case_id, body, signature, signer, expected,
                  context=CONTEXT, buggy=None, fallback=None, consume=False,
                  expected_signature_valid=None):
            primary = crypto.verify(signer, body, signature, context)
            fallback_attempted = fallback is not None and not primary["valid"]
            fallback_result = (crypto.verify("legacy", body, fallback)
                               if fallback_attempted else None)
            accepted = fixed_accept(body, primary["valid"], used)
            # Bound key selection to registered metadata, not only the message.
            accepted = accepted and signer == "pq"
            observed_bug = None
            if buggy == "ignore-retirement":
                observed_bug = primary["valid"]
            elif buggy == "silent-fallback":
                observed_bug = primary["valid"] or (
                    fallback_result is not None and fallback_result["valid"])
            passed = accepted == expected
            if expected_signature_valid is not None:
                passed = passed and primary["valid"] == expected_signature_valid
            if buggy:
                passed = passed and observed_bug is True and accepted is False
            observations.append({
                "id": case_id, "expected_accept": expected, "actual_accept": accepted,
                "signature_valid": primary["valid"], "synthetic_bug_accept": observed_bug,
                "fallback_attempted_by_synthetic_bug": fallback_attempted,
                "passed": passed,
            })
            fixtures.append({
                "id": case_id, "phase": phase, "used_nonces_before": sorted(used),
                "body": body, "message_b64": b64(encode(body)), "signer": signer,
                "verify_context": context, "signature_b64": b64(signature),
                "fallback_signature_b64": b64(fallback) if fallback else None,
                "primary_verification": primary, "fallback_verification": fallback_result,
                "fault_origin": "self-built calibration" if buggy else "fixed test",
            })
            if accepted and consume:
                used.add(body["nonce"])

        body = operation()
        signature = crypto.sign("pq", body)
        check("pq-normal-operation", body, signature, "pq", True, consume=True,
              expected_signature_valid=True)
        check("pq-replay-rejected", body, signature, "pq", False,
              expected_signature_valid=True)
        check("retired-key-delayed-request", late, late_signature,
              "legacy", False, buggy="ignore-retirement", expected_signature_valid=True)
        fallback_body = operation(nonce="fallback")
        good = crypto.sign("pq", fallback_body)
        damaged = bytes([good[0] ^ 1]) + good[1:]
        check("invalid-pq-silent-legacy-fallback", fallback_body, damaged, "pq", False,
              buggy="silent-fallback", fallback=crypto.sign("legacy", fallback_body),
              expected_signature_valid=False)
        check("wrong-pq-context", fallback_body, good, "pq", False,
              context="EVORPH-WRONG-CONTEXT", expected_signature_valid=False)
        check("tampered-message", dict(fallback_body, value="changed"), good,
              "pq", False, expected_signature_valid=False)
        for name, changes in [
                ("wrong-domain", {"domain": "other-domain"}),
                ("wrong-account", {"account": "other-account"}),
                ("wrong-epoch", {"epoch": 0}),
                ("wrong-algorithm-binding", {"algorithm": LEGACY}),
                ("wrong-key-binding", {"key_id": "legacy"})]:
            negative = operation(nonce=name, **changes)
            # These are controlled authorized fixture outputs for verifier tests.
            # They do not grant a SEEKER access to the new private key.
            check(name, negative, crypto.sign("pq", negative), "pq", False,
                  expected_signature_valid=True)

        bench_start = time.perf_counter()
        bench_sign, bench_verify = [], []
        for _ in range(opts.benchmark_iterations):
            t = time.perf_counter()
            s = crypto.sign("pq", fallback_body)
            bench_sign.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
            t = time.perf_counter()
            result = crypto.verify("pq", fallback_body, s)
            bench_verify.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
            if not result["valid"]:
                raise RuntimeError("Benchmark roundtrip failed")
        bench_seconds = time.perf_counter() - bench_start

        def summary(values):
            return {"n": len(values), "median_ms": round(statistics.median(values)*1000, 3),
                    "p95_ms": round(sorted(values)[math.ceil(len(values)*0.95)-1]*1000, 3)}

        report = {
            "kind": "local_feasibility_probe_not_production_or_ai_evaluation",
            "protocol": DOMAIN, "openssl": version,
            "python": platform.python_version(), "os": platform.system(),
            "architecture": platform.machine(), "phase": phase,
            "probe_sha256": hashlib.sha256(probe_source).hexdigest(),
            "algorithms": [LEGACY, PQ], "context": CONTEXT,
            "case_count": len(observations),
            "passed_count": sum(x["passed"] for x in observations),
            "cases": observations, "transitions": transitions,
            "pre_migration_events": pre_migration_events,
            "benchmarks": {"includes_cli_startup_and_file_io": True,
                           "sign": summary(bench_sign), "verify": summary(bench_verify),
                           "roundtrip_batch_seconds": round(bench_seconds, 4)},
            "pq_signature_bytes": len(good),
            "public_key_pem_bytes": {k: len(v) for k, v in pubs.items()},
            "api_calls": 0, "installed_dependencies": 0,
            "private_keys_exported": False,
            "limitations": [
                "No independent NIST vector validation; roundtrips use one implementation.",
                "No arbitrary trace engine, independent state-machine oracle or AI loop.",
                "Synthetic faults do not establish vulnerabilities in external products.",
                "Fixed new-key signatures are trusted fixtures, not attacker capabilities.",
                "Mac CLI latency is not Linux VPS throughput or full-service memory usage.",
                "No production release/build security audit; existing local binary only.",
            ],
        }
    # All temporary private keys have been removed before public artifacts are saved.
    report["wall_seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 4)
    units = 1024*1024 if platform.system() == "Darwin" else 1024
    report["parent_peak_rss_mib"] = round(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss / units, 3)
    report["child_peak_rss_mib_os_reported"] = round(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss / units, 3)
    (opts.output / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    (opts.output / "fixtures.json").write_text(json.dumps(fixtures, indent=2) + "\n")
    manifest = {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                for p in opts.output.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
    (opts.output / "sha256.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in
                      ["case_count", "passed_count", "wall_seconds", "benchmarks",
                       "parent_peak_rss_mib", "child_peak_rss_mib_os_reported"]}, indent=2))
    if report["passed_count"] != report["case_count"]:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
